sloka: ततः शिरस्ते निशितैः पातयिष्याम्यहं शरैः।मारुतः कालसम्पक्वं वृन्तात्तालफलं यथा ।। ६.७१.६१ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ śiraste niśitaiḥ pātayiṣyāmyahaṁ śaraiḥ।mārutaḥ kālasampakvaṁ vṛntāttālaphalaṁ yathā ।। 6.71.61 ।।

translations.english: "Then I will strike down his head with sharp arrows and throw him just as ripened palm fruit drops in the process of time."
